queue.title: Bank transfers
queue.empty: No transfers are waiting for a match.

transfer.title: Transfer {{reference}}
transfer.no_suggestions: No open bank transfer matches this amount or payer. Check the order number with the payer, or ignore the transfer.
transfer.ignore_reason_placeholder: Refunded to the payer, a test payment, a duplicate…
transfer.mismatch_body: The transfer is {{transfer_amount}} {{transfer_currency}} but order {{number}} owes {{session_amount}} {{currency}}. If you apply it anyway, the order is credited for what arrived.
transfer.pooled_warning: This account is pooled: other payers share its details, so only the reference separates them. Check the reference before applying.

record.title: Record a received transfer
record.description: Enter a transfer exactly as it appears on the bank statement. An exact match is applied at once; anything else waits in the queue.
record.applied: Transfer recorded and applied to order {{number}}.
record.queued: Transfer recorded. It is waiting in the queue for a match.
record.already_recorded: That transfer was already recorded. Nothing was applied a second time.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.description: Customers are quoted the offered account in their order's currency. Every active account is watched, so switching the offered one never strands an order in flight.
accounts.delete_body: Orders already quoted this account keep showing its details.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Sync from the provider, or add one by hand.
accounts.sync_nothing: Everything is already up to date.
accounts.synced_done: Accounts synced. Offer an account per currency for customers to be quoted it.
accounts.add_description: Enter the details customers pay into, exactly as your bank shows them.
accounts.created: Account added. Offer it for customers to be quoted it.

guide.title: Bank transfer setup
guide.webhook_url: Webhook URL to paste into the provider
guide.no_offered_account: No account is offered in any currency, so customers are not offered bank transfer. Open Bank accounts and offer one per currency.
